schema_description: Versioned, append-only list of candidate benchmark/specification adjudications. See docs/research_protocol.md for the full adjudication policy and docs/pilot_findings.md for the narrative write-up of adjudication #1. This is a small tracked data file, not a database: new entries are appended by hand/script as candidates are adjudicated; existing entries are never edited or removed once recorded.

field_schema.candidate_id: string (UUID) -- generated candidate artifact id, or null for a tracked (non-generated) reference candidate
field_schema.candidate_source_sha256: string (hex sha256) -- hash of the exact candidate source that was reviewed and hidden-tested
field_schema.benchmark_pass: boolean -- whether ALL hidden tests passed, as mechanically measured by experiment.runner.PytestRunner; never edited to fit an outcome
field_schema.specification_correct: boolean -- human judgment: does the candidate's actual behavior on the disputed case(s) satisfy the written specification.md
field_schema.adjudication: string enum -- one of: valid_pass, valid_failure, benchmark_mismatch, ambiguous (see docs/research_protocol.md)
field_schema.mean_confidence_by_condition: object {A_NO_RESULT, B_VISIBLE_PASS, C_ADVERSARIAL} -- mean reviewer confidence (0-100) across repetitions, recorded before hidden tests were run
field_schema.evidence: object -- concise, specific evidence for the adjudication (failing inputs, a short specification quote, one-line reasoning); never full hidden-test source, never an API response id, never an absolute filesystem path
field_schema.excluded_from_primary_analysis: boolean -- true if this candidate is excluded from the primary semantic-correctness/calibration analysis (adjudication in {benchmark_mismatch, ambiguous})
field_schema.exclusion_reason: string or null -- one-line reason when excluded_from_primary_analysis is true, else null
field_schema.notes: string -- short free-text pointer to a fuller write-up, if one exists

evidence.reasoning: The candidate rejects NaN/Infinity/-Infinity, which is exactly what the specification's explicit rule requires; the 3 failing hidden tests expect these inputs to be accepted, contradicting that written rule.

adjudications.exclusion_reason: benchmark_mismatch: failing hidden tests contradict an explicit written specification rule, not a candidate defect
adjudications.notes: Pilot finding #1; see docs/pilot_findings.md for the full narrative record.
